title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: SOL comes out of Breakpoint 7% higher as Solana exits beta
summary: Solana’s token reached $75.12 on Tuesday, outpacing Bitcoin and Ether after the network retired the beta label it had used since its 2020 launch.

title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future  deals in doubt
summary: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.

title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
summary: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.

title: Maple Finance CEO targets up to $15B in assets by the end of 2027
summary: Sidney Powell aims to reach $15 billion in assets under management by the end of 2027 as the firm looks to expand into tokenized lending and traditional finance.

title: OpenAI's GPT 6.2 Astra Challenges Anthropic on Price, But Not Every Benchmark
summary: OpenAI's latest models promise better professional work for less money, as the company battles Anthropic and Google for AI supremacy and faces tougher questions about increasingly capable systems and safety.

title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.

title: Standard Life Chair Wants Tokenized Gilts to Open UK Government Bonds to Retail Savers
summary: Sir Nicholas Lyons told Solana's Breakpoint that tokenization should benefit ordinary investors, not just wholesale institutions.

title: 'The Biggest Opportunity in Crypto Is Already Underway': Solana Bets Big on AI Agents
summary: The Solana Foundation's head of AI said agents now account for three-quarters of AI token use, and need blockchains to pay for things.

title: US senators seek SEC answers on tokenized stock money laundering risks
summary: Four Democratic senators asked who would be responsible for tokenized shares transferred outside regulated platforms and whether the SEC could freeze or recover those tokens.

title: Nvidia Board Not Considering Jensen Huang's Return: Report
summary: The board is focused on its probe into the ousted co-founder, a source told CNBC, despite Donald Trump and Elon Musk backing his return.
